title: Carrier Delivery-Day Calendar for Missed Guarantees on Late Delivery Claims
content:
Carrier Relations note for Delivery Claims: on a Late Delivery Claim, the days a delivery guarantee was missed by are counted on the carrier's delivery days, with an island transit allowance for Alaska and Hawaii.

**Counting rule.** The days the guarantee was missed by are counted on the carrier's delivery days, with the island transit allowance of Alaska and Hawaii: for an Expedited 2-Day order shipped to a state in the island list — Alaska (AK) and Hawaii (HI) — the counted days are the Monday-to-Friday days after the promised delivery date up to and including the delivered date, less 1 day of island allowance and never below zero; for any other order whose delivery service does not deliver on Saturdays, the counted days are the Monday-to-Friday days in that span; in every other case the counted days are the calendar days from the promised delivery date to the delivered date.

Whether a delivery service delivers on Saturdays is the service's own term in the Online Orders service schedule; the ship-to state is the state on the order's shipping address.

| Order | Days counted | Island allowance |
|---|---|---|
| Expedited 2-Day, shipped to AK or HI | Monday to Friday, after the promised date up to and including the delivered date | less 1 day, never below 0 |
| any other order on a service that does not deliver on Saturdays | Monday to Friday, after the promised date up to and including the delivered date | none |
| any other order | calendar days from the promised date to the delivered date | none |

## Worked calendar (hypothetical dates)

| Promised | Delivered | Monday-to-Friday days | Calendar days | Expedited 2-Day to AK or HI | Service without Saturday delivery | Service with Saturday delivery |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Friday | following Monday | 1 (Mon) | 3 | 0 | 1 | 3 |
| Thursday | following Tuesday | 3 (Fri, Mon, Tue) | 5 | 2 | 3 | 5 |
| Monday | Wednesday | 2 (Tue, Wed) | 2 | 1 | 2 | 2 |

An Expedited 2-Day order to a state other than AK or HI is counted as any other order: on Monday-to-Friday days when its service does not deliver on Saturdays.
